segments.title: Fallout 4: Cambridge Polymer Labs & The Castle Siege
segments.notes: Case Blackwell hosts an extended science-correspondent gameplay session as Chet Manscape, completing the Cambridge Polymer Labs quest, retaking the Castle for the Minutemen, and battling a legendary crab boss. Kendelle confirmed physically present in studio.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors the broadcast as Chet Manscape for a full Fallout 4 science-themed gameplay session.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. The on-air persona Case adopts throughout the stream; completes Cambridge Polymer Labs, takes the Castle, and fights a legendary crab.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Confirmed physically present in the studio during the gameplay session ("secret Kendall still here").

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Briefly referenced when Case jokes about having to "cup a pito off" to avoid politics.

lore_notes.fact: Kendelle is physically present in the studio during this broadcast.
Case Blackwell has a live show scheduled for 10:30 PM at the UCB theater in Los Angeles the following night.
Case Blackwell mentions a potential Chicago trip to see Andy and Chicago friends.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell delivers a feature-length Chet Guy the Science Eyes broadcast, steering a Fallout 4 playthrough through the Cambridge Polymer Labs quest, the Minutemen's Castle assault, and a drawn-out legendary crab boss fight. Kendelle is confirmed in the studio throughout, and Case closes by plugging a UCB theater show and a possible Chicago road trip.
